title.zh: 万有引力与轨道 · 横着扔出去，会落下、绕圈还是飞走
title.en: Gravity and Orbits · Throw It Sideways: Fall, Circle or Escape

desc.zh: 平方反比的引力加上一点横向速度：轨道从坠落变成椭圆、圆，再到逃逸；开普勒三定律从模拟里自己浮现。
desc.en: An inverse-square pull plus some sideways speed: the path turns from a crash into an ellipse, a circle, then an escape; Kepler’s three laws emerge from the simulation.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
